description: Booking links and contact details so a person can reach ClearMind Capital themselves. Individuals and families (planning, investments, estate plan) book with the Private Wealth team; business owners and HR leads (401(k), cash balance plans) book with the Workplace Retirement team. Returns links, phone, email, and the client login only. This server never books, submits, or stores anyone's information; hand the links to the person. No auth. For fees, services, or adviser credentials use get_firm_overview.

audience.description: individual_or_family for personal planning, business_owner for a company retirement plan. Omit when unsure to get both options.
